Mr. de Souza? I'm Nadia, your driver. Welcome. Are you tired?
Thank you. Yes, a little. I'm tired, because the flight is eleven hours.
Eleven hours! Is this your first time here?
No, it isn't. I'm here two or three times a year. And you? Are you from here?
Yes, I am. I live here. Forty minutes to the hotel, maybe fifty with the rain. Do you have family in Brazil?
Yes, two children. My son plays football and my daughter studies in another city.
Nice. Listen, a message from the front desk: the car tomorrow is at seven thirty, not at eight.
Of course. Tomorrow morning. Seven thirty, not eight. The traffic is bad after eight.
So, seven thirty, not eight. Is that right? And is there a restaurant near the hotel?
That is right. And yes — the Blue Door, two streets away, on the corner, opposite the bank.

Good evening, ladies and gentlemen, and welcome. The local time is six fifteen in the evening and the weather outside is cold, about seven degrees, with some rain. Please stay in your seat until we stop completely. Two things before you leave the aircraft. First, if this is your final destination, follow the blue signs after passport control, and your bags are on belt number four. Second, if you have a connection tonight, do not follow the blue signs. Go to the transfer desk on your right, and please go quickly, because the last flights of the evening leave in about fifty minutes. Thank you, and have a very good evening.

Hey, it is me. I am at the hotel now, and the day is good. Really good. The driver is at the airport at six fifteen, with my name on a sign. Twenty minutes in the car, and we talk in English. Only English, and no translator. Not perfect. Three or four times I am lost, and I ask him to repeat. And it is fine. At the hotel, I have a reservation: room five twelve, fifth floor. I say the number back, and then I am sure. At dinner, I order for myself: the fish. There is a woman at the next table, and she talks to me. And I am not quiet. I ask her: where are you from? That is the important part. Not the words. The part where I am not quiet.
Good evening. I have a reservation, my name is Leao de Souza. Room five twelve, fifth floor. What time is breakfast? And where is the Blue Door restaurant? Thank you very much.
